summary: New Oriental Education & Technology Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited financial results for the third fiscal quarter ended February 28, 2026. The filing contains no special-situation elements—it is a routine earnings release. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is disclosed. The filing reports year-over-year revenue growth of 19.8% to $1,417.3 million and net income growth of 45.3% to $126.8 million. It is a standard periodic financial report, not a special situation.
